approaches.name: Cosmic-Python layering + advanced-alchemy repositories + hand-rolled outbox/StageRunner
approaches.summary: Follow the Architecture Patterns with Python layout (repository, unit of work, message bus, service layer) and use advanced-alchemy's generic repository as the BaseRepository base. Build outbox relay and StageRunner ourselves on SKIP LOCKED, with a thin EventBus interface over aiokafka for OCI Streaming.
how: api/data: BaseRepository subclassing/modelled on advanced-alchemy SQLAlchemyAsyncRepository; UnitOfWork owns session and commit
Outbox table written in same UoW as work_item + history; relay loop claims rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED then publishes via aiokafka (SASL_SSL)
Abstract StageRunner template method: consume, claim, idempotency guard, service, persist+outbox, classify error to auto-fix
Build full-stack-fastapi-template conventions (uv, ruff, deps, OpenAPI-generated TS client) for scaffold story #1 and web client
Keep all rules in services; routers thin
evidence: litestar-org/advanced-alchemy (814 stars, pushed 2026-10-23) async generic repository, active, framework-agnostic
gh code search found only small outbox examples (aarthvr-b/transactional-outbox-python, 0 stars), so relay must be built in-house
risks: No mature public Oracle-specific outbox example; SKIP LOCKED on ATP must be verified
advanced-alchemy Oracle async support unproven; may need to copy patterns not depend
Cosmic Python repo last pushed 2025-06; patterns stable but not maintained

approaches.name: FastStream for bus consumers/producers behind EventBus
approaches.summary: Use FastStream (Kafka broker, AsyncAPI, DI, middleware) as the consumer framework for each station, wrapped by our EventBus and StageRunner interfaces; outbox relay still in-house.
how: FastStream KafkaBroker pointed at OCI Streaming Kafka endpoint with SASL_SSL
Each StageRunner registers as a FastStream subscriber; ack after DB commit via manual ack policy
Retry and DLQ via FastStream middleware/republish to stage.retry and stage.dlq topics
Lag/DLQ depth read via admin client for #29
Wrap broker behind EventBus so it can be swapped
evidence: ag2ai/faststream (5.4k stars, pushed 2026-10-22) active Kafka framework
IlyaGrebenschikov/FastAPI_example (11 stars) shows FastStream with FastAPI
risks: Extra framework dependency over aiokafka for a mandated EventBus abstraction; leaky abstraction risk
OCI Streaming Kafka compatibility is partial (no transactions, limited admin API); FastStream features may assume more

approaches.name: Durable-workflow engine (Temporal) instead of outbox + bus
approaches.summary: Model each work item as a Temporal workflow with activities per station, getting retries, signals for receipt-arrived and history for free.
how: One workflow per work_item, activities per stage
Receipt watcher sends signal to waiting workflows
DB remains system of record via activities
Auto-fix as activity retry policies and child workflows
evidence: temporalio/sdk-python (1.2k stars, active) mature durable execution
risks: Contradicts CLAUDE.md mandates (OCI Streaming bus, transactional outbox, EventBus); needs Jonathan's approval
Adds self-hosted infra not available as OCI managed service
Selective re-drive and human lock/requeue semantics must be re-modelled
